name: New User Onboarding
primary_user_goal: Get from landing page to first successful deployment
business_goal: Maximize activation rate by minimizing time-to-first-deploy
entry_point: Landing page or GitHub OAuth callback
exit_point: Successful first deployment with running service
friction_points: GitHub OAuth permission scope may concern some users
Repository selection can be overwhelming for users with many repos
optimization_notes: Railway optimizes heavily for GitHub-based deployment, making this the golden path. Template deployment offers an alternative for exploration.

name: Service Deployment Flow
primary_user_goal: Deploy new code or service to the platform
business_goal: Make deployment so easy users prefer Railway over alternatives
entry_point: New Service button on canvas or GitHub push
estimated_completion_time: 30 seconds for configuration, 2-5 minutes for build
friction_points: Custom Dockerfile setups need more configuration
optimization_notes: Framework auto-detection removes most configuration decisions. Nixpacks build system handles most languages automatically.

name: Template Marketplace Deployment
primary_user_goal: Deploy a pre-configured application stack without manual setup
business_goal: Reduce time-to-value and showcase platform capabilities
entry_point: Template marketplace or direct template link
exit_point: Fully configured project with all services running
friction_points: Some templates require environment variable configuration
Complex templates may need post-deploy setup steps
optimization_notes: One-click deploy button minimizes friction. Templates include sensible defaults. Post-deploy instructions guide users through any required configuration.

name: Database Provisioning Flow
primary_user_goal: Create a managed database and connect it to my application
business_goal: Increase platform stickiness through data service adoption
exit_point: Running database with connection string in environment variables
friction_points: Users may not understand connection string format
Data import from external databases requires manual steps
optimization_notes: Auto-generated connection strings with reference syntax enable zero-config database connections. Canvas visualization shows database as connected service.

name: Environment Configuration Flow
primary_user_goal: Manage environment variables and project settings
business_goal: Enable proper configuration management for production readiness
friction_points: Variable reference syntax has learning curve
Environment inheritance can be confusing initially
optimization_notes: RAW editor mode enables bulk editing. Import from .env reduces migration effort. Preview shows resolved values before deploy.

name: Log Debugging Flow
primary_user_goal: Diagnose and fix issues with running services
business_goal: Enable self-service debugging to reduce support burden
entry_point: Logs tab or deployment failure notification
exit_point: Identified issue with clear path to resolution
friction_points: Log retention limits on free tier
Complex distributed issues span multiple services
optimization_notes: Color-coded log levels enable quick scanning. Search and filtering narrow down issues. Deployment-specific logs isolate changes.

name: Project Canvas Management
primary_user_goal: Visualize and manage complex multi-service architectures
business_goal: Demonstrate value of Railway for growing infrastructure
exit_point: Organized canvas with all services visible
friction_points: Large projects can become visually cluttered
optimization_notes: Zoom and pan enable navigation of complex canvases. Connection lines auto-route to minimize crossing. Service cards collapse to reduce clutter.

name: Usage and Billing Flow
business_goal: Build trust through transparency and prevent bill shock
entry_point: Usage menu item or spending alert
exit_point: Clear understanding of costs with optional spending limits set
friction_points: Usage-based pricing can feel unpredictable initially
optimization_notes: Real-time cost estimation provides immediate feedback. Spending limits prevent unexpected charges. Service attribution enables targeted optimization.
